tasks.title: Scaffold the Bun + TypeScript app with the module boundary map

details.goal: Create an installable Bun/TS project whose package.json#imports map is the module boundary, with every script later phases need frozen up front.
details.contract:
package.json must contain exactly: {"name":"codegraph-mvp","type":"module","private":true,"imports":{"#shared/*":"./src/shared/*"},"scripts":{"mcp":"bun run bin/codegraph.ts","index":"bun run bin/codegraph.ts index","status":"bun run bin/codegraph.ts status","dev":"bun --watch run bin/codegraph.ts","test":"bun test","typecheck":"tsc --noEmit","lint":"biome check src tests bin","build":"bun build --compile bin/codegraph.ts --outfile dist/codegraph","db:generate":"drizzle-kit generate","db:drift":"drizzle-kit generate --name drift-check && git diff --exit-code src/shared/store/migrations","db:parity":"bun test tests/schema-parity.test.ts","acceptance":"bun test tests/acceptance.test.ts"}}.
dependencies: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.2, drizzle-orm 0.45.4, web-tree-sitter 0.27.2, tree-sitter-wasms 0.1.13. devDependencies: typescript ^5.9, @types/bun latest, @biomejs/biome ^2, drizzle-kit 0.31.11.
tsconfig: strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, verbatimModuleSyntax, moduleResolution bundler, types ["bun"], include ["src","tests","bin"], paths {"#shared/*":["./src/shared/*"]}.
biome.json must enable the rule that enforces the stdout discipline: suspicious/noConsoleLog as an error over src, tests and bin (console.error and the shared logger remain allowed).
.gitignore: node_modules, dist, .codegraph, *.db, *.db-wal, *.db-shm, .DS_Store.
bin/codegraph.ts: shebang #!/usr/bin/env bun, parse argv[2] mode: mcp (default) | index | status | worker; delegate to ../src/index.ts main(mode, argv); on unknown mode print usage to stderr and exit 2. Must never write to stdout in worker mode.
Do not create anything under src/shared/ — TASK-002 owns the kernel.
steps: Create app/package.json with the imports map, the twelve scripts and pinned dependencies above
Create app/tsconfig.json with the strict flags and the #shared/* path mapping
Create app/.gitignore and app/biome.json including suspicious/noConsoleLog as an error
Create app/bin/codegraph.ts with the mode dispatch and stderr-only usage text
Run bun install to produce bun.lock, then tsc --noEmit to confirm the toolchain
Confirm no script later phases need is missing by grepping package.json for acceptance, lint, db:drift and db:parity
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun install && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc --noEmit; echo exit=$?. Done when exit=0, bun.lock exists, grep -c '#shared' package.json prints 2, and package.json contains the acceptance, lint, db:drift and db:parity scripts.

tasks.title: Kernel: config, structured logging, error codes, root stub

details.goal: Provide the three kernel modules every other module imports, and a composition-root stub so `bin/codegraph.ts` resolves.
details.contract: config.ts exports type AppConfig and loadConfig(): AppConfig reading env CODEGRAPH_DATA_DIR, CODEGRAPH_REPO_ROOT, CODEGRAPH_PROFILE (default agent) and defaulting dataDir to <repoRoot>/.codegraph; no other module may read process.env. log.ts exports log with debug/info/warn/error writing JSON lines {ts,level,msg,...fields} to stderr only. errors.ts exports class AppError extends Error with code from the closed union: wrong_project_db | unsupported_filesystem | schema_too_new | cursor_invalid | cursor_expired | cursor_mismatch | budget_too_large | bootstrapping | not_found | ambiguous | index_locked | internal, plus toErrorPayload(e). paths.ts exports normalizeRel(p) returning repo-relative forwards-slash with no leading dot-slash, qn(relPath, scope, name) returning relPath::Scope.name, and prefixBounds(p) returning the ONLY correct half-open range for a path prefix: match when path equals p OR (path > p + '/' AND path < p + '0'). The naive form path >= p AND path < p + '0' is forbidden because it also matches siblings such as src-old for prefix src. src/index.ts exports async function main(mode: string, argv: string[]): Promise<number>; for now every mode logs 'not implemented' to stderr and returns 2. No tool registration yet — TASK-027 owns that. Subpath imports only (#shared/config), there is no barrel index.ts in shared.
steps: Write config.ts with the AppConfig type and env-driven loadConfig including CODEGRAPH_PROFILE
Write log.ts emitting JSON lines to stderr
Write errors.ts with the AppError class and the closed code union
Write paths.ts with normalizeRel, qn and the corrected prefixBounds
Write src/index.ts main() stub returning 2 for every mode
Add a test asserting a log call produces no stdout output and that prefixBounds rejects the src-old sibling
details.verify: `cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc --noEmit && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun -e 'import {log} from "#shared/log"; log.info("x"); process.stdout.write("");' 1>/tmp/out.txt; wc -c </tmp/out.txt` — Done when typecheck exits 0 and /tmp/out.txt is 0 bytes.

tasks.title: Envelope, emit() budget chokepoint, signed cursors

details.goal: Implement the single response contract, the single size chokepoint and stateless cursors, so no tool can invent its own shape or size policy.
details.contract:
envelope.ts exports type Envelope<T> with NINE REQUIRED fields that are always present — status, summary, read_status, coverage, totals, truncated, truncation_reason, next, next_tools — plus payload:T, plus ONE OPTIONAL field error that is present if and only if status is error or bootstrapping. read_status is {generation, indexed_at, stale, stale_reason?, stale_checked_at?}. coverage is {complete, indexed, skipped, failed, unresolved_edges, not_indexed[]}. totals is {*_total, total_relation: eq|gte}. error is {code, message, hint?, retryable?, retry_after_ms?} — retry_after_ms is what status bootstrapping carries. Constructors ok/ambiguous/notFound/fail/bootstrapping return the full shape and never a partial object.
budget.ts exports emit(env, budgetTokens, opts: {mint: (position: number) => string}) which is the ONLY place a payload is truncated: it serialises, measures at 4 bytes per token, drops lowest-ranked items from the largest list until within budget, preserves every *_total, sets truncated, truncation_reason and next via opts.mint (it cannot sign a cursor itself), and DOWNGRADES totals.total_relation from eq to gte whenever it truncates, because only emit knows truncation happened. It refuses budgetTokens above 32000 with AppError code budget_too_large rather than truncating silently.
Cursor signing is TASK-036; this task only calls the injected mint callback. No source file in shared may construct an Envelope literal outside envelope.ts.
steps: Write envelope.ts with the nine required fields, the conditional error field and stale_checked_at in read_status
Write budget.ts with ranking-aware truncation, the mint callback, the gte downgrade and the 32000 ceiling
Write tests/envelope.test.ts asserting the nine required fields on all constructors and error presence only for error and bootstrapping
Write tests/budget.test.ts as the property test plus the gte downgrade, the mint-called-once case and the ceiling
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc --noEmit && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/envelope.test.ts tests/budget.test.ts. Done when both files pass, the property test reports 0 violations, a truncated payload shows total_relation gte with next set from the mint callback, and budget 40000 returns budget_too_large.

tasks.title: Boundary test: no cross-module imports, Drizzle confined to store

details.goal: Make module isolation a test failure instead of a review comment.
details.contract: Test walks every .ts under app/src and app/tests with `new Bun.Transpiler({loader:"ts"}).scan(source)`, then asserts: files under src/tools/<a>/** may import only "#shared/*" and "./" siblings inside the same tool; files under src/indexer/** likewise "#shared/*" plus local siblings; files under src/shared/** must not import "#tools" or "#indexer" or "../tools"/"../indexer"; the specifier "drizzle-orm" may appear only in files under src/shared/store/**; no file outside src/ may be scanned. Failure message must name the offending file, the import path and the rule broken. The test must pass on the empty tree of this phase (it will only find src/index.ts, config.ts, log.ts, errors.ts).
steps: Enumerate .ts files with a recursive read of app/src and app/tests
Scan each with Bun.Transpiler().scan() to get import paths
Implement the rule table for tools/indexer/shared
Add the drizzle-orm location assertion
Add a self-check that a synthetic violating source string fails the checker
details.verify: `cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/boundary.test.ts` — Done when the test passes, and the included self-check proves a string importing "../trace/handler" from a tool directory is rejected.

tasks.title: Drizzle schema and initial migration for the ten modeled tables

details.goal: Declare the graph schema in Drizzle and commit the generated initial migration.
details.contract: schema.ts declares eleven tables from DATABASE.md section 3 with explicit snake_case column names: file, node, edge, node_metrics, not_indexed, unresolved, tombstone, generation, meta, node_fts_state, node_vector. node_vector is created but stays empty in the MVP (no embeddings), so DATABASE.md section 3.6 and plan.risk.md remain literally true. Indexes per DATABASE.md section 4: node(qn) unique, node(name,kind), node(file_id,start_line), node(parent_id), node(kind), edge(dst_id,kind,tier), edge(src_id,kind,tier), edge(file_id,line), edge(kind), file(path) unique, file(language), not_indexed(path), unresolved(file_id), node_metrics(is_entry), node_metrics(tested_depth). Foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE from node.file_id, edge.src_id/dst_id/file_id and unresolved.file_id. edge carries local_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT empty string inside its unique key (src_id,dst_id,kind,file_id,line,local_name). drizzle.config.ts: defineConfig with dialect sqlite, schema ./src/shared/store/schema.ts, out ./src/shared/store/migrations. Commit the generated 0000_init.sql AND the drizzle meta directory (meta/_journal.json plus the snapshot), because the no-drift CI check regenerates and compares. Do NOT model node_fts (FTS5) here, TASK-006 owns it.
steps: Write app/src/shared/store/schema.ts with the eleven tables and the index list above
Write app/drizzle.config.ts pointing at schema.ts and migrations/
Run drizzle-kit generate --name init to produce 0000_init.sql plus migrations/meta/
Read the generated SQL and confirm every index and FK from DATABASE.md section 4 is present
Confirm no table is missing by diffing the generated DDL against DATABASE.md section 3
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x drizzle-kit generate --name init && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc --noEmit. Done when migrations/0000_init.sql exists with 11 CREATE TABLE statements and the 15 named indexes, migrations/meta/_journal.json exists, and typecheck exits 0.

tasks.title: Migration runner, FTS5 raw migration, schema parity test

details.goal: One migration runner, one ledger, two SQL streams, plus the parity test that keeps schema.ts honest.
details.contract: migrate.ts applies in order every sql file in store/migrations/ (drizzle-kit stream) then every sql file in store/migrations/raw/ (hand-written stream), one transaction per file, recording (name, applied_at) in table schema_migration and setting meta.schema_version to the applied count. Rules: forward-only, no down migrations; duplicate-column and already-exists errors are swallowed so a partially applied migration is re-runnable; a database whose recorded version is higher than the code is refused with AppError code schema_too_new; when meta.rebuild_required is 1 the runner returns a flag so the indexer forces a full index. Do not import drizzle-orm/bun-sqlite/migrator in this file. raw/0001_fts.sql creates node_fts as FTS5 external content over node_fts_state, tokenize unicode61 remove_diacritics 2, columns name, qn, signature, docstring, props_text. tests/schema-parity.test.ts migrates an empty temp DB then compares every table against getTableConfig from drizzle-orm/sqlite-core: column names, index names, FK targets, failing on any difference.
steps: Write migrate.ts with the two-stream applier, the schema_migration ledger and the schema_too_new guard
Write migrations/raw/0001_fts.sql creating node_fts over node_fts_state
Write tests/schema-parity.test.ts comparing a migrated DB against getTableConfig
Run the parity test and fix any drift between schema.ts and the generated SQL
Confirm re-running migrate on an already-migrated DB is a no-op
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/schema-parity.test.ts. Done when parity passes and a second migrate call on the same file applies 0 files and sets no new schema_version.

tasks.title: Connection lifecycle, prepared-statement cache, portable write lock

details.goal: Connection lifecycle with the right PRAGMAs, a bounded prepared-statement cache, and a portable single-writer lock since Bun has no flock.
details.contract: db.ts exports openReader(path) using readonly true with PRAGMAs foreign_keys=ON, busy_timeout=10000, cache_size=-16384, mmap_size=268435456; openWriter(path) with journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, cache_size=-65536, mmap_size=268435456, busy_timeout=10000, journal_size_limit=67108864, foreign_keys=ON; db(conn) returning a Drizzle instance; prepared(sqlKey, build) implementing a bounded LRU of max 200 prepared queries plus statementCacheStats(). URI filenames must not be used anywhere (bun:sqlite cannot open them). lock.ts exports acquireLock(dataDir) creating dataDir/write.lock with flag wx containing JSON pid and startedAt, release(handle), and inspect(dataDir) returning held, pid, stale. Stale means the pid is not alive or the lock mtime is older than 60s; acquire reclaims a stale lock and logs a warning. Use node:fs/promises, no shelling out.
steps: Write db.ts with openReader, openWriter and the exact PRAGMA sets
Add the prepared-statement LRU with statementCacheStats()
Write lock.ts using exclusive-create with PID and startedAt
Implement stale detection with reclaim and a warning log
Write tests/lock.test.ts for index_locked on a second acquire and successful stale reclaim
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc --noEmit && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/lock.test.ts. Done when typecheck passes and the test proves index_locked on the second acquire and reclaim of a stale lock.

tasks.title: Staged publish protocol: stage, seal, rename, guaranteed discard

details.goal: Make a partial graph unpublishable by construction.
details.contract: publish.ts implements DATABASE.md section 5: stage(livePath) returns a stage path live.stage.<rand>, seeded empty on force full or by VACUUM INTO from the live file; beginWrite(stage) opens a writer and returns a transaction scope using drizzle db.transaction(cb, {behavior: immediate}) noting the callback runs immediately and returns its value; seal(stage) runs wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE), journal_mode=DELETE, synchronous=FULL, quick_check(1) and throws AppError internal on failure; publish(stage, live) renames over the live file and deletes stale -wal/-shm sidecars; discard(stage) removes the stage and its sidecars. Expose withStage(livePath, fn) that calls discard in a finally so an error can never reach publish.
steps: Write publish.ts with stage, beginWrite, seal, publish, discard
Implement withStage(livePath, fn) that always discards on throw
Use VACUUM INTO for the stage seed
Write tests/publish.test.ts covering the success path and the throw path
Assert the live file sha256 is unchanged after an aborted publish
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc --noEmit && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/publish.test.ts. Done when both cases pass and the aborted case reports an unchanged live-file sha256.

tasks.title: Typed read primitives: nodes, edges, metrics, coverage

details.goal: Typed read primitives for nodes, edges, metrics and coverage, built on the prepared-statement cache.
details.contract: Each file exports domain row types (never Drizzle inferSelect types across the boundary) and functions: nodes.ts findByQn(conn, qn), findByName(conn, name, kinds), members(conn, parentId), nodesByFile(conn, fileId); edges.ts inbound(conn, ids, kinds), outbound(conn, ids, kinds); metrics.ts metricsFor(conn, ids) returning in_degree, out_degree, is_entry, tested_depth, reachable_count; coverage.ts rowsForPaths(conn, paths) and unresolvedForFiles(conn, fileIds). rowsForPaths uses the corrected prefix rule from #shared/paths prefixBounds: a path matches when it equals the request OR is strictly between request + '/' and request + '0' — never the naive path >= p AND path < p + '0' form, which also matches src-old for prefix src. Read files.ts and the GraphReader aggregate are TASK-034; diff is TASK-035. All queries go through prepared(key, build) from #shared/store/db and are prepared once per shape. No ranking, no limits, no formatting, no envelope construction here. Every function takes a connection handle first so tests can pass a temp DB.

Write edges.ts with directional lookups by kind using the composite indexes
Write metrics.ts for degree, entry and tested_depth
Write coverage.ts including the corrected prefix-range query and unresolved lookup

tasks.title: Domain functions: resolve, neighbors, coverage assembly, risk, diff

details.goal: Encode the three contracts that must exist once and never be reinvented per tool: resolution with ambiguity, grouped neighbour expansion, absence assembly, and the risk formula.
details.contract:
resolve.ts: resolve(conn, query, kinds) returns {status: ok, node} | {status: ambiguous, candidates up to 5 with qn, kind, file, lines, score, why} | {status: not_found, near_misses}. It must never pick when 2 or more candidates tie; detection order is exact qn, exact name plus kind, dotted tail, path, then @decorator treated as a property filter. neighbors.ts: expand(conn, seedIds, {direction, depth<=4, kinds}) returns groups keyed by edge kind and tier, each item carrying id, qn, kind, file, line, hop, external flag; intentionally unbounded, no truncation. coverage.ts: assemble(conn, scope) returns coverage, unresolved rows, and relation which is eq only when complete, unresolved is empty for the scope and the generation is fresh; otherwise gte. risk.ts: score(changed, impacted) returns score, band and drivers as sentences.
The change-set diff function lives in TASK-035 (domain/diff.ts); this task must not duplicate it. tests/domain.test.ts covers the ambiguity refusal and the eq-versus-gte matrix using a fake GraphReader, not a database.
steps: Write resolve.ts with the ambiguity contract and the kind inference order
Write neighbors.ts producing grouped-by-kind-and-tier output with hop and external flags
Write coverage.ts deriving eq versus gte from unresolved and not_indexed
Write risk.ts producing driver sentences, not a bare number
Write tests/domain.test.ts against a fake GraphReader for ambiguity and the eq/gte matrix
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc --noEmit && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/domain.test.ts. Done when a two-candidate tie returns ambiguous with 2 candidates, coverage returns gte whenever an unresolved row exists in scope, and risk returns at least one driver sentence.

tasks.title: Phase 0 closing gate: smoke, contract and boundary verification

details.goal: Prove phase 0 delivers its contracts before any parser or tool code is written.
details.contract: smoke.test.ts: create a temp repo dir, run migrate, open a writer, insert one file and two nodes, publish through withStage, then open a reader and read them back. contract.test.ts: assert every envelope constructor returns the nine required fields with no undefined omissions and that error is present only for error and bootstrapping; assert emit never exceeds budget plus 10 percent on 200 generated payloads and downgrades to gte when truncating; assert cursor verify refuses a token minted for a different tool and for a different generation; assert the corrected prefixBounds excludes src-old for prefix src. This task owns no source files and must not modify any.

details.contract: cursor.ts exports sign(payload:{generation, tool, argsHash, position}) returning an opaque token, and verify(token, {tool, argsHash, generation}) returning a discriminated result (ok with decoded position) | cursor_invalid | cursor_expired | cursor_mismatch. HMAC-SHA256 over a key from env CODEGRAPH_CURSOR_KEY with a length check at startup; the key never leaves this module. Expiry is generation-bound, not time-bound: a token whose generation differs from the current one is cursor_expired with hint re-run the original call, and a token whose tool or argsHash differ is cursor_mismatch. Tokens are base64url of payload plus 16-byte tag; no database table and no server memory. tests/cursor.test.ts covers round trip, tampered tag, expired generation, mismatched tool and mismatched argsHash.
details.goal: Stateless signed cursors that make pagination stable within a generation and provably refuse a stale page.
steps: Write cursor.ts with sign and verify plus the key load and length check
Encode payload as base64url with a 16-byte HMAC tag
Implement the three refusal codes with the tool and argsHash checks
Write tests/cursor.test.ts for the five cases
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/cursor.test.ts. Done when all five cases pass and a token minted for one generation is refused as cursor_expired under another.

tasks.title: File census primitives and the GraphReader interface

details.contract: diff.ts exports changedSince(repoRoot, base) returning {changed: string[], removed: string[], unmatched: Array<{path, reason}>} computed as the union of git diff --name-status against base and a sha256 comparison of working-tree bytes against the file table. Rules: a git failure degrades to hash-only comparison and records degraded: true in the result rather than throwing, because the integration fixture is a plain temp directory that is not a git repository; every git invocation is bounded by a 30 s timeout; paths outside the repo root are dropped; a changed path with no file row and no parseable language lands in unmatched with a reason instead of disappearing; no writes of any kind.
details.goal: One change-set computation shared by summary and impact, usable in a non-git directory.
steps: Write diff.ts with the git diff call and the 30 s timeout
Add the sha256 comparison against the file table and union both sources
Implement the non-git degradation with degraded: true
Collect unmatched paths with reasons
Write tests/diff.test.ts covering a git fixture, a non-git directory and an unmatched markdown file
details.verify: cd app and run: $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/diff.test.ts. Done when a modified file appears in changed, a deleted file in removed, a markdown change in unmatched with a reason, and a non-git directory returns degraded true without throwing.
